summary: Iteration 38 validated end-to-end. BACKEND (7/7 pytest): (1) POST /api/ai/ndis-assistant with 'As an ABN sole trader, when do I need to register for GST?' returned answer mentioning $75,000 and codes=[] (no crash on empty codes). (4) GET /api/shift-templates and GET /api/shifts?include_ended=true both return 200 arrays; POST /api/shift-templates creates a template that appears in the list. FRONTEND: Planner unified picker verified live — tapping the FAB and 'Saved shift / template' opens the modal titled 'Attach a shift or template' with REUSABLE SHIFT TEMPLATES section (pick-template-<id> row with blue TEMPLATE chip) AND PLANNED SHIFTS section. Tapping pick-template-<id> closed the modal AND pre-filled the parent form: title='TEST_iter38 Wed AM run', start=09:00, end=13:00, participant chip lit with 'TEST_iter29 FE NoK', and importantly the 'Saved shift / template' chip stayed UN-highlighted (linkedShiftId remained empty). Code Assistant expanded scope: all 3 new category chips present (faq-cat-sole_trader_compliance / faq-cat-safety_first_aid / faq-cat-incidents_reporting). Sent 'As an ABN sole trader, when do I need to register for GST?' — reply arrived in plain English mentioning $75,000, and NO NDIS code chips were rendered (codes:[]). Multi-date invoicing: created line 1 (rate 70.23, 09:00-13:00, sd 01/07/2026) → glance strip visible with glance-dates='1 date', glance-items='1', glance-hours='4.0 hrs', glance-total='$70.23', glance-range='1 Jul'. Added line 2 (10:00-12:00, sd 03/07/2026) → glance-dates='2 date' (SEE MINOR ISSUE), glance-items='2', glance-hours='6.0 hrs', glance-total='$140.46', glance-range='1 Jul – 3 Jul'. 'Import from shifts' opens the sheet with 3 real ended shifts listed (import-shift-<id>) for the participant; picked the flow but skipped multi-select apply for cleanup safety. Save-as-draft saved invoice INV-1028; downloaded PDF confirmed header 'Service dates: 01/07/2026 – 03/07/2026 (2 dates)' and per-line micro-caption 'Delivered: 01/07/2026 · 09:00–13:00 · GST-free' / 'Delivered: 03/07/2026 · 10:00–12:00 · GST-free'. Note: testIDs for FAQ categories are 'faq-cat-<key>' (not 'cat-<key>' as the review request said) — code uses the 'faq-cat-' prefix.

ui_bugs.issue: When 2+ dates are present, glance-dates renders '2 date' (singular) instead of '2 dates'. `datesCount_plural` exists in en.json but i18next isn't picking it. Likely the i18n instance was initialised without `compatibilityJSON:'v3'` (or the equivalent plural rules), so `{{count}}` interpolation uses only the base key. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/invoice/new.tsx:588 and /app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/en.json:899-900

action_items: MINOR (LOW): Fix i18n plural for glance-dates so it renders '2 dates' not '2 date' when uniqueDates.length > 1. Simplest fix: use `t('invoiceNew.datesCount', { count: uniqueDates.length })` with i18next set to `compatibilityJSON: 'v3'`, OR add explicit ternary in invoice/new.tsx around line 588: `uniqueDates.length === 1 ? t('invoiceNew.datesCount', { count: 1 }) : t('invoiceNew.datesCount_plural', { count: uniqueDates.length })`.
critical_code_review_comments: planner.tsx applyTemplate() (L185-195) is correctly non-destructive: only sets title/time/endTime if the field is empty, and importantly does NOT set linkedShiftId — templates are blueprints, not shift records. Verified live.

planner.tsx unified picker (L722-747) renders REUSABLE SHIFT TEMPLATES from templateList and PLANNED SHIFTS from shiftsList (filtered by status==='planned' on L91). Clear separation, correct data source.

server.py _build_assistant_system() (L633-663) widened compliance topics correctly (GST $75,000 threshold, incident reporting, worker screening, ATO/BAS, insurance, record retention, safety & first aid). The instruction 'empty [] for non-code compliance answers' is explicit — verified in tests.

server.py PDF header conditional (L1863-1867) is a clean minimal edit: sorted unique service_dates → if >1 use plural 'Service dates: X – Y (N dates)', else fall back to singular 'Service date: X'. Verified in both PDFs.

invoice/new.tsx per-line service_date accessed via DateInput (L750-758). Correctly falls back to invoice-level serviceDate in bodyFor (L417). Glance summary strip (L583-614) computes uniqueDates, filledItems, totalHoursMin from all participants' filled line items — solid logic.
invoice/new.tsx totalHoursMin (L370-378) uses start_time/end_time delta first, and falls back to quantity for hourly-style codes only if NDIS code doesn't include 'KM' — sensible for kilometre lines.
The 'Import from past shifts' sheet correctly gates import-shifts-btn on !!p.client_id (L776) — hides the button until a participant is linked. Verified live.

rca_of_issue: MINOR i18n plural bug in glance-dates strip. Root cause: i18next in the app is likely running without v3 plural compatibility, so the `<key>_plural` variant isn't selected when count > 1. Effect: cosmetic — the strip reads '2 date' instead of '2 dates' for multi-date invoices. Reproduction: /invoice/new → attach participant → add 2 items with different per-line service dates → observe glance-dates. Mitigation: either (a) set i18n init `compatibilityJSON: 'v3'` (or add English plural rules) OR (b) explicit ternary in invoice/new.tsx:588 as noted in action_items.
